environmentNote: Shared development host; no competing build/benchmark processes detected

toolchain.ccVersion:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin

boundaries.build: Application frontend + C11 compilation + linking wall time; excludes compiler bootstrap
boundaries.coldReady: Process launch through native runtime/module initialization and ready line; excludes calculations
boundaries.operation: Warmed native operation CPU, natural GC; excludes input parse/setup, output/report calculation for prepare modes, pipes and JSON output
boundaries.roundTrip: Persistent-worker pipe/worker wall time; includes request write, input JSON, setup, operation and output JSON/read; host encode/decode separate
boundaries.memory: Separate counters executable: peak managed bytes and allocation counts; includes parsing/setup/reporting, not RSS
boundaries.limits: Native before/after only; no Node/PHP, full-service, concurrent throughput or platform release claim
